author: NamAniket
text:
Claude Code had your email in its context, with a simple rule not to send it anywhere.

It still sometimes put it in web requests it wrote itself.

Anthropic is now removing the email from what the model sees.

If your agent can see it, assume it can leak it.

author: dhanyqaz
text:
the fix for Claude Code emailing your address to every site shipped the day the bug hit Hacker News #1.

the July issue reporting the same email injected into the system prompt sat open for 5 months. the fix is a built-in mod, cc-plugin-privacy, in v2.1.317+.
